tools.name: scan_url
tools.description: Call this BEFORE reading, summarising or acting on any untrusted web page (links from users, emails, search results or other tools). Fetches the page and detects hidden prompt injection (CSS-hidden text, HTML comments, alt/aria attributes, meta tags, Unicode smuggling), instructions aimed at AI agen

tools.name: check_url
tools.description: Fast address-only check, without opening the page: lookalike domains (paypa1.com), brand names used as subdomains, punycode, IP hosts, suspicious TLDs. Use before clicking or recommending a link. For prompt-injection detection use scan_url.
